hook: Your helicopter has flown on Mars, 72 times.
title: A Helicopter Flew on Mars 72 Times
description:
In April 2021, NASA's Ingenuity made the first powered, controlled flight on another planet. It was planned as a five-flight demo. It went on to fly 72 times.

Series: If You Were on Another World.
comment_prompt: Would you fly it? Yes or no
